criterion: For every completed independent reference answer, subtract the second-largest raw logit from the largest raw logit. Preserve every row and every hit; do not use correctness labels for selection.
followup_order: source order, then row order; record all hits, diagnose at most the first 18
scope: Numerical boundary observation on already viewed audit data. No prompt, threshold, training or calibration selection; not an independent language quality test. Failed and unprocessed rows remain in the planned denominator.
